每行一个 ID，或用逗号分隔；最多 30 个。角色或用户匹配任意一项即可。: Enter one ID per line or separate them with commas, up to 30. A matching role or user ID grants access.
管理员例外已关闭，且未指定角色或用户：当前无人可以创建或修改开放报名卡。: Administrator access is disabled and no roles or users are allowed. No one can currently create or edit open sign-up cards.
未选择时仅允许通用通知频道；选中后仅允许这些频道。卡片发布到使用指令的频道。: If none are selected, only the general notification channel is allowed. Otherwise, only the selected channels are allowed. Cards are published in the channel where the command is used.
可填写多个 Discord 文本频道 ID，每行一个或用逗号分隔，最多 30 个: Enter up to 30 Discord text channel IDs, one per line or separated by commas.
使用 /newwipe 选择服务器并设置下一次 Wipe，发布后可通过卡片的设置: Use /newwipe to select a server and configure the next wipe. After publishing, use the card’s Settings button to make changes. Members sign up directly with Discord; no website account or Steam link is required.
此功能默认停用。启用后，在“服务器与频道”分配功能并配置使用权限、可用频道；保存: This feature is disabled by default. Enable it, assign it under Servers and channels, and configure access permissions and allowed channels. Save, then register /newwipe under Tools.
